CC = gcc
BUILD ?= build
CFLAGS = -std=c11 -O2 -fPIC -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-function -Wno-unused-parameter
SOURCES = src/replay_api.c src/roce_packet.c src/star4_switch.c src/sha256.c
HEADERS = include/epic_clean.h include/offline_api.h include/switch_ctx.h \
          include/sha256.h
.PHONY: all clean
all: $(BUILD)/libepic.so
$(BUILD)/libepic.so: $(SOURCES) $(HEADERS)
	mkdir -p $(BUILD)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -Iinclude -shared $(SOURCES) -o $@
clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD)
BUILD OK
PASS: empty-capture
PASS: one-allreduce
2/2 public examples passed
